visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A chef wearing a black T-shirt and purple nitrile gloves uses a metal hook to lift a whole, steamed, pale-yellow goose from a large stainless steel pot filled with clear, steaming broth. The setting is a brightly lit professional kitchen with stainless steel counters. (2) Close-up on a thick wooden circular cutting board where the chef uses a large metal cleaver to swiftly chop the goose into thin, uniform slices. The meat appears succulent with a layer of glistening fat. (3) A white oval plate with blue floral patterns is filled with the sliced goose meat. A large metal ladle pours a hot, clear, oily broth over the arranged slices. The background shows stacks of bowls and kitchen equipment. (4) Close-up of a pair of chopsticks picking up a single slice of goose meat with fatty skin, dipping it toward a small white dish containing an orange-brown dipping sauce. (5) In a large steaming pot, a ladle scoops out yellow bamboo shoots in a clear soup and pours them into a white bowl. The steam rises visibly from the pot. (6) Cubes of dark purple-black goose blood cake are dipped into a steaming vat of broth using a large slotted ladle, then shown held by chopsticks to emphasize their texture. (7) Bright green, shiny sautéed cabbage leaves are shown being picked up by chopsticks from a white plate, highlighting their fresh and oily surface. (8) An overview shot of a table setting featuring the plate of goose meat, a bowl of bamboo soup, a plate of blood cake, a plate of cabbage, and two bowls of rice. (9) A woman with short dark hair wearing a black and red uniform and a blue surgical mask stands inside the restaurant, looking toward the camera. In the background, several patrons are seated at white tables under bright indoor lights. (10) The camera transitions to an exterior shot of a storefront with a large red sign containing yellow and blue Chinese characters: "新營鵝肉 吃懷念" above a street with modern city buildings in the background.

The narrator's speech rate is moderately fast but remains intelligible. (3) Subtle splashing sounds of broth being ladled and poured are audible between phrases of narration. There is a low-level background room tone consisting of faint restaurant chatter and kitchen ambient hum, adding authenticity to the recording. (4) The audio concludes with a final summary recommendation from the narrator. The background music maintains its steady rhythm and fades out alongside a brief increase in urban exterior ambient noise as the shop front is shown.
